title: The category of étale algebras with a prime and a residue-field embedding
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $p\in\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $K$ be a field, and let $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ be a field homomorphism [def-weil-residue-field]. An etale residue triple is $(B,\alpha,q,\phi)$, where $\alpha:A\to B$ has etale spectrum map [def-weil-etale-morphism], $q\in\operatorname{Spec}B$ maps to $p$, and $\phi:\kappa(q)\to K$ is compatible with $\chi$ over $\kappa(p)$. Its associated map $\psi:B\to K$ is $B\to\kappa(q)\xrightarrow{\phi}K$. The category has as morphisms $A$-ring maps $\beta:B\to B\prime$ with $\psi\prime\circ\beta=\psi$, equivalently $\beta^{-1}(q\prime)=q$ and $\phi\prime\circ\kappa(\beta)=\phi$. The forgetful ring diagram sends a triple to $B$ and a morphism to $\beta$. Residue fields here are those of the affine schemes [def-pc-scheme].
